Pairs for a list inside a list: the first for the main items, the second for the items under them.

Making a whole list

Pasting a bullet in front of every line works, but it gets slow. In InstaStylr you make a real list, choose any of these bullets for it, and press Tab to put items under others. The lists tutorial shows how, step by step.

Emoji bullets such as 🌸 look different on each phone. The plain symbols look the same everywhere.
